title: The Friday Problem
brief: Since October, the Coding Club's events look half empty. The president wants to swap workshops for socials, and has to tell the sponsor who pays for the workshops by Friday.
story: The Coding Club has a problem. Since October, its events have looked more and more like half-empty classrooms.
The president thinks they know why: "Maybe students just aren't interested in workshops anymore. Should we replace them with more social events?"
But there's a catch. Quillmoor Software, the club's sponsor, pays for those workshops. The sponsor renewal meeting is this Friday, and the president doesn't want to make the wrong call.
assumption: "Students are bored with workshops. Let's replace them with more socials."
question: Why are our events half empty: the topics, the timing or the promotion? And what should we change next semester?

hypotheses.title: The topics
hypotheses.suspicion: Students are getting bored with workshops.
hypotheses.challenge: Compare workshops with the other event types. Are the topics really the problem?

hypotheses.title: The promotion
hypotheses.suspicion: Maybe we're not promoting our events enough.
hypotheses.challenge: Look at the promotion posts. Does less promotion mean fewer people?

hypotheses.title: The timing
hypotheses.suspicion: Perhaps we run events at the wrong times.
hypotheses.challenge: Look at when events take place. Do some days or time slots do worse?

mustInclude.title: The big finding
mustInclude.text: A headline that tells the president what you found, in one sentence.

mustInclude.title: The key number
mustInclude.text: At least one KPI with an important result.

mustInclude.title: The visual evidence
mustInclude.text: At least one chart that proves your finding.

mustInclude.title: The next move
mustInclude.text: What the club should do next semester.

hints.text: People can sign up for an event and then not come. Compare registered with checked_in. Where are the missing people?
Workshops look worst. But when were they held? Compare the same topic on different days.

deliverable: Page 1 of your app: the finding, a key number, a chart that proves it, and the next move.
